verdict.rationale: Clara documents a public API that covers corporate spend management end to end: issuing and managing cards, retrieving transactions, handling users and processing invoices. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 schema for typed clients and function calling, plus LLM-oriented reference docs, and probes confirm `openapi.json` and `llms.txt` are live. Credentials are self-serve from the dashboard, and a sandbox supports safe end-to-end testing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that live API calls work as documented (probes only confirm the docs and schema are reachable).
